# AdyDaddy

> AdyDaddy is a performance marketing agency that plans, builds, and scales paid media, SEO, and content programs that turn ad spend into revenue — for D2C and growth-stage brands.

Founded by Vibhor Sharma, AdyDaddy treats ad spend as an investment, not a budget line. Every engagement is scoped against payback and profitable revenue rather than vanity metrics.

## Services

- [Performance Marketing](https://www.adydaddy.com/services/performance-marketing): ROAS-driven paid media across Meta, Google, and YouTube.
- [SEO](https://www.adydaddy.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, content, and authority building that compounds organic traffic.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.adydaddy.com/services/social-media-marketing): Organic content, community, and creator partnerships that build demand.
- [Content & Creative](https://www.adydaddy.com/services/content-and-creative): In-house ad creative, video, and design built for performance.
- [Marketing Automation & CRM](https://www.adydaddy.com/services/marketing-automation-crm): Lifecycle email, SMS, and CRM flows that lift repeat revenue.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://www.adydaddy.com/services/conversion-rate-optimization): Structured experimentation that lifts conversion without more spend.
